attempts.summary: Created a local Root CA named "OS Comparison Root CA" on node1 (4096-bit RSA key, self-signed, 10-year validity), installed its certificate into /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/ and activated it system-wide with update-ca-trust extract. Verified trust via `trust list` (anchor) and `openssl verify`. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id, rebooted node1 via `sudo reboot`, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed (98aa35f5... -> 69b4ee23...), and reverified the CA remained trusted and the system fully healthy (systemctl is-system-running -> running) after restart.
